actions._comment: Florida voter registration search. Names are indexed last name first. The page lists at most 100 rows, the rest are paginated and not scanned.
The results table renders on a hit and on a miss; a miss has no data rows.

Rows read 'LAST FIRST MIDDLE' and 'STREET CITY ZIP' with no comma or state, which C-S-S cannot match. Reorder the name to first-last using the user's last name, and add the comma and FL before the zip using the user's own cities so multi-word cities split correctly.
actions.script: var last=((userProfile&&userProfile.lastName)||'').toUpperCase().trim();var cities=[];((userProfile&&userProfile.addresses)||[]).forEach(function(a){if(a&&a.city)cities.push(a.city.toUpperCase().trim());});if(userProfile&&userProfile.city)cities.push(userProfile.city.toUpperCase().trim());root.querySelectorAll('#voter_results tr[data-county]').forEach(function(tr){var n=tr.cells[1]&&(tr.cells[1].querySelector('a')||tr.cells[1]);var a=tr.cells[2];if(!n||!a)return;var t=n.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');var sfx='';var sm=t.match(/ (JR|SR|II|III|IV|V)$/);if(sm){sfx=sm[0];t=t.slice(0,-sfx.length);}if(last&&t.toUpperCase().indexOf(last+' ')===0){n.textContent=t.slice(last.length+1)+' '+t.slice(0,last.length)+sfx;}else{var i=t.indexOf(' ');if(i>0)n.textContent=t.slice(i+1)+' '+t.slice(0,i)+sfx;}var s=a.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');var m=s.match(/^(.*?)\s+(\d{5})(\d{4})?$/);if(!m)return;var body=m[1],up=body.toUpperCase();for(var k=0;k<cities.length;k++){var c=cities[k];if(c&&up.length>c.length+1&&up.slice(-c.length-1)===' '+c){a.textContent=body.slice(0,body.length-c.length-1)+', '+body.slice(-c.length)+', FL '+m[2];return;}}a.textContent=body+', FL '+m[2];});

actions._comment: Redaction is per page and needs a valid email address.
The page URL must be the voter page itself. Its change handler fetches it and only then can the submit button enable.
No fillForm type carries free text, so set the reason directly.
actions.script: var r=root.getElementById('request_reason');if(r){r.value='Personal privacy. Please remove my name and address from this page.';r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}

actions._comment: Ticking the box re-runs validation, which enables submit once the page URL has resolved.
Shown after a successful submission, with the request summary. Approval is manual and takes up to 72 hours.
